_purpose: Canonical decision: exactly one workflow MUTATION authority. The discovery notes flagged three 'competing workflow engines'; on reading the code they are three different concepts. This records the one authority and reclassifies the others.
rationale: lib/workflow-manager.js is the persisted, typed, resumable node-graph engine: run/resume/fork/checkpoint, approval + interrupt nodes, state reducers, SQLite workflow_runs + workflow_checkpoints. 9 live consumers. Matches spec 3.6 (WORKFLOW HARNESS).

event-workflow.concept: event/message-passing workflow (AutoGen / MS Agent Framework typed messages)
event-workflow.note: unwired; superseded by workflow-manager as the mutation authority. Retained read-only for its canonical message contract; NOT an authority. Migrate/retire under the supervisor consolidation.

recipe-manager.concept: linear YAML macro — sequential prompt/tool/recipe steps, no run persistence
recipe-manager.note: distinct capability, not a workflow authority. Escalate to workflow-manager for branching, parallelism, approvals or resumable runs.
